test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 09 Dec 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word.**

The soldiers were __irresolute__ and so, they won the war for the infantry and the country.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4** i.e. **decisive**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"irresolute"** means uncertain and unable to make decisions.

 
 
• **Hindi Meaning:** अनिश्चयशीलता
 
• **Example:** He stood irresolute at the crossroads, not knowing which way to go.
 
 
 
• **"Decisive"** is the antonym of irresolute, meaning having or showing the ability to make decisions quickly and effectively.
 
 
• **Hindi Meaning:** निर्णायक
 
• **Example:** A decisive leader is needed in times of crisis.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **decisive**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Harsh** (कठोर): Rough and unpleasant, especially to the senses.

 
 
• **Example:** The harsh weather conditions made it difficult to survive.
 
 
 
• **Variant** (प्रकार): Different or distinct from others of the same kind.
 
 
• **Example:** This variant of the software includes several new features.
 
 
 
• **Default** (डिफ़ॉल्ट): Failure to fulfill an obligation, especially to repay a loan or appear in a court of law.
 
 
• **Example:** If you default on your loan payments, you could lose your car.
